decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, 1703 EX00, 1703 EX01, 1703 EX02, 1703 EX03, 1703 EX04, and 1703 EX05 received: 25 May 2017. 1703 PA30 Rev A , 1703 PA31 Rev A, 1703 PA32 Rev A 1703 PA33 Rev A, 1703 PA34 Rev A, 1703 PA35 Rev A and 1703 PA36 Rev A received: 5 July 2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Other than the balcony area shown in the approved drawings, the flat roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension at lower ground level with roof terrace above. One large door encompassing two existing French doors to proposed ground floor roof terrace and a stairwell to the side of the house.
